name: Fiend's Panoply
kind: armour set for the villagers (skinned to their CharacterArmature)
description: Blackened demon-iron edged in gold, sworn to Lord Velscour: his full sigil on a silver breast panel and on a crimson cape, a saw-toothed fin down the spine, an asymmetric spiked great pauldron, gold-rimmed lames, V-bossed knees, an embroidered loincloth, and a black great helm with gold ram's horns and slotted breaths.

meshes.Armor: body, arms, legs and the set's gauntlets

hide_when_worn: the villager's body meshes (every mesh not named V_*)
